love-light-palms.blurb:
New to Reiki? Begin with a Complimentary First-Time Experience.
Love & Light Palms is a holistic wellness practice founded in February 2026 by Charla Woods-Favors, a certified Usui Reiki Level II Practitioner in Columbus, Ohio.
We provide a welcoming, compassionate environment where individuals can explore relaxation, energetic balance, self-awareness, and personal reflection.
Our services include Reiki Healing, Chakra Balancing, Aura Cleansing, and Akashic Records Reading.
A complimentary 20-minute first-time Reiki experience is available by appointment, in person in Columbus or through distance Reiki, allowing newcomers to explore Reiki in a comfortable setting.
Whether you're seeking a moment of stillness, renewed clarity, or a deeper connection with yourself, you are welcome here.
Healing Begins Within.
You Matter. You Belong Here.
Learn more and schedule your experience at www.Loveandlightpalms.com.
